title: Early bass players: Data Jackson, Henry Kimball, Bebe Ridgley
summary: He remembers Data Jackson, who played bass fiddle before tuba, and Henry Kimball playing with Bebe Ridgley.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
